name: Buildora – PC Builder for WooCommerce
author: Ripon Hossain Chopol

sections.description:
Buildora PC Builder for WooCommerce is the complete PC building solution for WooCommerce stores that sell computer hardware. It guides your customers step-by-step through selecting compatible PC components, then adds the entire build to the WooCommerce cart in a single click.

Perfect for:
* Custom PC retailers — sell workstations, gaming rigs, office builds, server configurations
* Hardware stores — help customers match a CPU to a motherboard, RAM, GPU, PSU, and more
* System integrators — showcase pre-configured build templates that customers can tweak
* eLearning / hobbyist stores — guide new builders through the PC building process

Core Features

  • 🧩 17 Component Types Included — CPU, Motherboard, RAM, Storage, Graphics Card (GPU), Power Supply (PSU), Case, CPU Cooler, Monitor, Mouse, Keyboard, Case Fans, Headset, Wi‑Fi Adapter, Speakers, Antivirus Subscription, and UPS
  • ✅ Compatibility Engine — Real-time Warnings — Instant compatibility feedback with helpful warnings when incompatible parts are selected (CPU socket vs motherboard, RAM generation, PSU wattage vs draw, form-factor vs case, GPU length vs case clearance, and more) — shown after component selection
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Cart Integration — One-click “Add to Cart” adds every selected component as a separate line item (or grouped) so the customer can checkout directly
  • 💾 Build Templates — Create pre-configured build templates (Budget, Gaming, Workstation, Office, etc.) that customers can start from or load with one click
  • 👤 My Account Saved Builds — Logged-in customers can save up to 5 builds and revisit them from the WooCommerce My Account area
  • 🧭 Setup Wizard — Onboarding wizard auto-detects existing product categories and recommends mappings, plus optional demo-data import for instant testing
  • 📊 Admin Dashboard — Dashboard with build overview, monthly charts, top-selling components, quick-action shortcuts, and system status checks
  • 🗺️ Component Category Mapping — Smart keyword-based auto-detection maps WooCommerce product categories to component types (CPU, GPU, RAM, etc.)
  • 📋 Product Specs Meta — Core Specs — Dedicated product-spec fields on each WooCommerce product (socket, RAM type, form-factor, RAM slots, PSU wattage, chipset, TDP, storage interface) used by the compatibility engine
  • 🎨 Customizable Builder Design — 2-color accent and background customization that matches your store branding
  • 🖨️ Basic Print — Print button for hardcopy of the current configuration
  • 📤 Copy to Clipboard — One-click copy of build summary to share via email / chat
  • ⚙️ Gutenberg Block + Elementor Widget + Shortcode — Embed the builder anywhere:
    • Gutenberg Block: [PC Builder]
    • Shortcode: [bpcb_pc_builder]
    • Elementor Widget: “PC Builder”

Privacy Notices

Buildora PC Builder for WooCommerce is designed with privacy in mind:

  • No data is sent to external servers. All core features (builder UI, compatibility engine, cart integration, saved builds) run entirely locally on your own WordPress/WooCommerce installation.
  • Saved builds are stored as WordPress user meta (bpcb_builds) and only for logged-in users that explicitly click Save Build.
  • No cookies are set by the plugin beyond the standard WordPress/WooCommerce login and session cookies.
  • No tracking, telemetry, or usage data is collected or transmitted.

When using the demo-data importer, demo products are created only when you explicitly click “Import” in the Setup Wizard or Tools page. Imported demo content can be bulk-deleted from PC Builder → Tools → Remove Demo Data.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or greater
  • PHP 7.4 or later (PHP 8.0+ recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater OR MariaDB 10.1 or greater

Automatic installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Buildora PC Builder for WooCommerce”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin after installation

After activation

  1. You will be redirected to the Setup Wizard automatically
  2. Follow the wizard to:
    • Map your existing WooCommerce categories to PC component types (or auto-create them)
    • Optionally import demo products and specs for testing
    • Create and configure the PC Builder page
  3. Open the Builder Page and start building!

Quick start (no existing products)

  1. Activate the plugin and run the Setup Wizard
  2. On the Demo Data step, click Import Full Demo — categories, 60+ demo products, specs, compatibility rules, and 3 pre-made build templates will be created
  3. Open the Builder — everything works out of the box
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. The plugin was built for WooCommerce product catalogs and the cart/checkout flow.

Will it work with my theme?

PC Builder uses its own isolated React-based UI that’s rendered via shortcode, Gutenberg block, or Elementor widget. It includes responsive styling and works with any properly-coded WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Can I change which component types appear?

Yes. Go to PC Builder → Settings → Components and toggle rows on/off, reorder them, or change their labels. The plugin includes all 17 standard PC components.

Where are product specs stored?

PC Builder adds its own dedicated spec meta fields to WooCommerce products. Edit any product and use the PC Builder Specs panel to fill in socket, TDP, chipset, form-factor, RAM slots, PSU wattage, etc. These specs power the compatibility engine.

How many builds can a customer save?

Logged-in customers can save up to 5 builds.

Can builds be shared with customers or on social media?

Customers can copy a plain-text build summary to clipboard.

Is HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) supported?

Yes. The plugin declares WooCommerce HPOS compatibility via the official FeaturesUtil::declare_compatibility method.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. The text domain is buildora-pc-builder and a .pot file is included in the languages/ folder.

Is personal data collected?

No. PC Builder does not send any data to external servers. Saved builds are stored locally as WordPress user meta. See the Privacy section below.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org
  • React-based PC Builder UI with Classic layout
  • 17 standard component types (CPU, Motherboard, RAM, Storage, GPU, PSU, Case, Cooler, Monitor, Mouse, Keyboard, Fans, Headset, Wi‑Fi, Speakers, Antivirus, UPS)
  • Real-time Compatibility Engine with warnings (shown after selection)
  • WooCommerce cart integration (complete builds only)
  • Setup Wizard with smart category detection + demo data import
  • Admin Dashboard with charts + quick actions
  • Saved Builds (5 per logged-in user) with My Account endpoint
  • Build Templates
  • Gutenberg Block + Elementor Widget + Shortcode
  • Core Product Specs meta on WooCommerce products
  • 2-color builder design customization
  • Basic print + clipboard share
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility declared
